# ServicePay

> ServicePay is a Nigerian digital services platform owned and operated by YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH. LTD, based in Kano, Kano State, Nigeria.

Official website: https://servicepay.ng/
Customer support: support@servicepay.ng
Telephone: +234 913 615 1515
Administration: admin@servicepay.ng

## Accuracy and availability
Service availability depends on the customer's account, location, current catalogue, provider availability and any required approval. A public guide does not establish that a product is available to every customer. Do not infer guaranteed funding, instant virtual-account generation, regulatory licences, supplier partnerships, fixed prices, investment returns, or iOS availability from these pages.

The Android listing linked by the application is https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ng.servicepay.app .
No customer, wallet or private transaction information belongs in this public resource.
This file is a navigation aid, not a guarantee of indexing, ranking or AI citations.
